temporal_reference: static model, no departure-time or live traffic parameter
raw_response_policy: Actual allowance is first revealed by response headers, not guessed from public plan limits; check available remaining quota before subsequent requests and stop on 401/403/429. Preserve successful and failed original responses immutably with payload, time, source IDs and SHA-256; never archive Authorization headers. Reuse SHA-verified completed cells even when adding endpoints; flag graph/version differences across batches.
scope_note: Planner makes no API request. Collector requests only independently verified endpoints; unresolved endpoints remain represented. No threshold or exposure replacement.
